Title: Modal doesn't open
Description: When user runs /secret command the modal fails to open with no error shown
Root Cause: Missing app.view handler registration in index.ts for the modal callback_id
Proposed Solution: Register app.view('secret_modal') handler in index.ts
Effective Solution: Added app.view('secret_modal') handler in index.ts that calls handleModalSubmit
Changelog/Edits Made: src/index.ts: Added app.view('secret_modal') handler

Title: handleModalSubmit not defined
Description: Runtime error handleModalSubmit is not defined when modal is submitted
Root Cause: Missing import statement for handleModalSubmit in index.ts
Proposed Solution: Import handleModalSubmit from bot/modals in index.ts
Effective Solution: Added import statement for handleModalSubmit in src/index.ts
Changelog/Edits Made: src/index.ts: Added import for handleModalSubmit

Title: Cannot read properties of undefined reading id
Description: Runtime error when accessing body.channel.id during modal submission
Root Cause: Body object structure different than expected - channel field not present in modal submission
Proposed Solution: Use optional chaining and fallback to container.channel_id
Effective Solution: Updated modals.ts to use (body as any).channel?.id with fallback to container.channel_id
Changelog/Edits Made: src/bot/modals.ts: Fixed channel ID extraction with optional chaining and fallback

Title: Button value has literal placeholder
Description: Button value shows {{secret_id}} instead of actual UUID in Slack
Root Cause: buildPlaceholderBlocks not receiving actual secretId from modal submission
Proposed Solution: Pass secret.id to buildPlaceholderBlocks function
Effective Solution: Updated modals.ts to pass secret.id to buildPlaceholderBlocks and updated view-builder.ts function signature
Changelog/Edits Made: src/bot/modals.ts: Pass actual secretId to buildPlaceholderBlocks src/slack/view-builder.ts: Updated function signature

Title: Missing text argument in chat.postMessage
Description: Slack API warning about missing text argument in message post
Root Cause: chat.postMessage called without text parameter
Proposed Solution: Add text argument alongside blocks
Effective Solution: Updated modals.ts to include text: Secret shared by ${senderName}
Changelog/Edits Made: src/bot/modals.ts: Added text argument to chat.postMessage

Title: Receiver cannot view message
Description: When recipient clicks View Secret no text is delivered to their DM
Root Cause: Recipient view flow not properly decrypting the secret - ciphertext stored but plaintext never extracted
Proposed Solution: Implement proper decryption flow using decryptSecret with envelope and master key
Effective Solution: Updated actions.ts handleRecipientView to use decryptSecret with proper envelope construction including encryptedDataKey from DB
Changelog/Edits Made: src/bot/actions.ts: Fixed recipient view to use proper decryption src/db/secrets.ts: Added encryptedDataKey parameter

Title: Receiver sees Viewed By button
Description: Recipient can see and click Viewed By button but nothing happens
Root Cause: No mechanism to hide buttons per user - Slack Block Kit renders same buttons to all viewers
Proposed Solution: Post separate messages to sender and recipient - recipient DM gets only View Secret button
Effective Solution: Added buildRecipientPlaceholderBlocks function that only includes View Secret button Updated modals.ts to post simplified DM to recipient
Changelog/Edits Made: src/slack/view-builder.ts: Added buildRecipientPlaceholderBlocks src/bot/modals.ts: Post separate DM to recipient with limited buttons

Title: Cancel button not working for receiver
Description: Receiver clicks Revoke but nothing happens - should be sender-only
Root Cause: Auth check exists in handler but button shouldn't be visible to receiver anyway
Proposed Solution: Since recipient gets separate DM with only View Secret button this issue is resolved by fix #7
Effective Solution: Resolved by implementing separate recipient DM message
Changelog/Edits Made: See fix #7 - recipient DM only has View Secret button

Title: No message in origin channel
Description: When /secret is run in a channel no message appears in that channel
Root Cause: Placeholder was being posted to recipient DM instead of origin channel
Proposed Solution: Post placeholder to originChannelId where command was run
Effective Solution: Updated modals.ts to post placeholder to origin channel and separate DM to recipient
Changelog/Edits Made: src/bot/modals.ts: Post placeholder to originChannelId not recipient DM

Title: Sender not getting revoke button
Description: Sender cannot see or click the Revoke button in the message
Root Cause: Same root cause as #7 - buttons rendered to everyone but sender expects different behavior
Proposed Solution: Sender sees message in origin channel with all 3 buttons - this is working as designed
Effective Solution: Confirmed sender sees all buttons in origin channel - no code change needed

Title: Message obfuscated to receiver
Description: Receiver sees garbled text instead of secret when clicking View Secret
Root Cause: Ciphertext stored in DB as base64 but recipient view tries to convert raw bytes to UTF-8 string instead of decrypting
Proposed Solution: Use decryptSecret function with proper envelope instead of direct UTF-8 conversion
Effective Solution: Updated actions.ts to construct proper envelope and call decryptSecret before sending plaintext to recipient
Changelog/Edits Made: src/bot/actions.ts: Use decryptSecret with envelope instead of Buffer.toString utf-8

Title: No message seen in channel where initiated
Description: When /secret @user is run in a channel the placeholder doesn't appear there
Root Cause: Origin channel ID extraction failing - falling back to unknown and posting to DM
Proposed Solution: Fixed channel ID extraction to properly get channel from body or open DM as fallback
Effective Solution: Updated modals.ts with better channel ID extraction and fallback logic
Changelog/Edits Made: src/bot/modals.ts: Improved originChannelId extraction with DM fallback

Title: Column encrypted_data_key does not exist
Description: Database error when trying to create secret - column missing from secrets table
Root Cause: Migration 002_add_encrypted_data_key.sql not applied successfully during earlier session
Proposed Solution: Manually ran ALTER TABLE to add column then verified it exists
Effective Solution: Created migration file and ran manually via psql command
Changelog/Edits Made: src/db/migrations/002_add_encrypted_data_key.sql: Created file src/db/secrets.ts: Added column to schema

Title: Wrong secret key for ciphertext
Description: Crypto error when decrypting - wrong secret key for given ciphertext
Root Cause: encryptDataKey generates random nonce but decryptDataKey uses zero nonce - they don't match
Proposed Solution: Fixed decryptDataKey to extract nonce from beginning of encrypted data instead of using zero nonce
Effective Solution: src/crypto/master.ts: Fixed decryptDataKey to extract nonce from encrypted data

Title: nonce.copy is not a function
Description: Runtime error when trying to copy nonce during encryption
Root Cause: libsodium returns Uint8Array not Buffer - Uint8Array has no copy method
Proposed Solution: Wrapped sodium output with Buffer.from to convert to Buffer before using copy
Effective Solution: src/crypto/master.ts: Wrapped nonce and encrypted output with Buffer.from

Title: trigger_id not defined for view opening
Description: Error opening modal for sender self-view - trigger_id required but not available
Root Cause: SocketModeReceiverOptions doesn't accept signingSecret and trigger_id not passed from Bolt action args
Proposed Solution: Moved signingSecret to App constructor Instead of opening modal for sender use ephemeral message
Effective Solution: src/index.ts: Moved signingSecret to App constructor src/bot/actions.ts: Changed sender self-view to use ephemeral message

Title: Ephemeral messages don't self-destruct
Description: Sender ephemeral messages stay in DM history indefinitely creating security risk
Root Cause: Ephemeral messages in Slack don't auto-delete - they persist in conversation history
Proposed Solution: Schedule BullMQ job to delete ephemeral message after 5 minutes using chat.delete
Effective Solution: Added delete job scheduling after sending ephemeral message in handleSenderSelfView
Changelog/Edits Made: src/bot/actions.ts: Schedule delete job for ephemeral message after sending

Title: Hide Secret button not appearing
Description: After recipient views secret the placeholder stays as View Secret instead of showing Hide Secret
Root Cause: chat.update call failing silently - message ts or channel id not available in action body
Proposed Solution: Added debug logging to identify missing fields and improved message ts extraction
Effective Solution: src/bot/actions.ts: Added detailed logging for placeholder update conditions

Title: Cancel doesn't delete placeholder message
Description: When sender revokes the secret the placeholder message with buttons still stays in channel
Root Cause: chat.delete for placeholder not working - likely message ts not available in action body
Proposed Solution: Improved cancel action with better message ts extraction and logging
Effective Solution: src/bot/actions.ts: Enhanced cancel action with fallback message ts extraction

Title: Permanent announcement missing in channel
Description: User wants permanent message in channel showing who sent secret to whom that doesn't get deleted
Root Cause: Only interactive placeholder was posted - no permanent announcement message
Proposed Solution: Added separate permanent announcement message that stays in channel after interactive placeholder is deleted
Effective Solution: src/bot/modals.ts: Post permanent announcement alongside interactive placeholder src/slack/view-builder.ts: Added buildPermanentAnnouncementBlocks

Title: Dynamic configuration without restart
Description: User wants to modify timing configs without restarting the bot
Root Cause: No dynamic config system - all timings hardcoded in constants or .env
Proposed Solution: Implemented config file with hot-reload polling every 60 seconds
Effective Solution: src/config/timing.ts: Created dynamic config loader with polling src/bot/modals.ts: Use config for expiry src/bot/actions.ts: Use config for delete delay

Root Cause: Hide Secret action not implemented - only placeholder update was done
Proposed Solution: Implemented handleHideAction that deletes DM message and placeholder instantly
Effective Solution: src/bot/actions.ts: Added handleHideAction src/index.ts: Registered secret:hide action src/slack/view-builder.ts: Added buildAfterViewPlaceholderBlocks with Hide Secret button
